about_the_game:
Find your missing friend. Uncover the secrets within.

In Dead Take, you play as an actor. You're uneasy; your friend won't answer the phone. Delve into the gilded rot of the entertainment industry and show up at the last place he was before he went quiet: a dark, opulent mansion.

Advance into the house by solving object-based puzzles and splicing together the video clips you find along the way. The house is oddly quiet for the site of a glamorous party just hours before.

As you advance toward the heart of the mansion, the fate of your friend rests in your hands. Will you find him and uncover the truth about what happened last night?

Feed me something real

KEY FEATURES:

Step into an actor's shoes

Set out on a haunting single-player story shaped by real experiences in the entertainment industry. Discover the monstrous cost of creation for yourself.

Make your way through the mansion, piecing together the story of how far a powerful executive will go to seal his legacy. As the actor, peer into the dark corners of the house and of your own mind.

Uncover the secrets of the mansion

Solve object-based puzzles to progress deeper into the mansion, from the front gate all the way to the home cinema.

As you advance, discover and edit together the video clips you find to unravel what really happened within these walls.

Creep through hallways and up or down staircases to progress through the grand foyer, art gallery, audition room and more in this single-player first-person psychological horror.

Peel back the glittering façade

Discover a side of the entertainment industry only discussed in whispers: the cruelty and sordid gossip, the roles gone wrong, unsettling audition tapes and shadowy figures with the power to make or break your career.

Make your way through opulent and meticulously hand-crafted 3D rooms, full of tools and props inspired by real-world film sets, accompanied by composer Ross Tregenza's chilling original score.
